summary: Expose multipack validation through the main CLI and prepare its installable release

delivery.outcome: Deliver the public multipack validation CLI and release projections as Wellman 0.21.0 via Goal and independent protected merge; verify the installed wheel and use the declared Goal registry publication path after trusted merge.
nonGoals: Treating candidate validation as canonical standard conformance or release authority

architecture.decision: A thin CLI adapter delegates to the existing offline validator; example and installed-distribution checks bind the public entrypoint to its declaration-only behavior.
architecture.rollback: Reviewed revert or subsequent compatible release; never overwrite a published artifact.

validation.evidence: CLI works outside Git and retains structured failures and no authority
Install the wheel in a separate venv and invoke its real console entrypoint outside the source tree
Goal -a and exact-head independent approval before merge; separate registry readback after publication
